overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a Purpose 1 executive session notice and announcement may omit the names of individuals to protect privacy, and the law does not require stating why names were withheld.

allegations.summary: Alleged the May 8 notice and pre-session announcement for a Purpose 1 executive session did not name the individuals or say why names were withheld.
allegations.key_passage: When discussing an individual in executive session pursuant to Purpose 1, a public body may omit identifying information about that individual from the meeting notice where the body is concerned about protecting the privacy of that individual.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
